title: First-level Fourier weight of a signed tail function
statement: For each real number $t$, let $F_n$ be the function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ that equals the indicator of $n^{-1/2}\\sum_{i=1}^n x_i>t$ minus the indicator of $n^{-1/2}\\sum_{i=1}^n (-x_i)>t$. As $m$ tends to infinity, the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $F_{m+1}$ over all singleton coordinate sets tends to $4\\,\\varphi(t)^2$, where $\\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density.
